signals.title: Puppet Show: Kose Bose (Косе Босе)
signals.reason: A delightful, visually expressive puppet classic about a clever little blackbird outsmarting a fox, perfectly suited for a 4-year-old on a cold winter weekend.

signals.title: Puppet Play: Grandpa's Mitten (Дядовата ръкавичка)
signals.location: Konstantin Velichkov Drama and Puppet Theatre, Pazardzhik
signals.reason: A charming, easy-to-follow winter stage production about animals finding shelter in a lost mitten, an easy 35-minute drive from Plovdiv and ideal for bad weather.
signals.note: Confirmed on kupibileti.bg and theatrepazardzhik.com; venue is ~35 minutes from Plovdiv.

signals.title: 'Christmas in Plovdiv' Open-Air Holiday Fair
signals.reason: Festive holiday village featuring a two-story carousel, snowless sledding slide, illuminated Christmas displays, and Santa's mailbox right in the city center.

signals.title: Plovdiv Christmas Tree Illumination Ceremony
signals.reason: The official lighting of the municipal Christmas tree with holiday music and lights in the main town square, timed early enough for a 4-year-old's bedtime.

signals.title: Puppet Show: Who Am I? (Кой съм аз?)
signals.reason: A sensory-friendly, low-dialogue morning performance where picture-book animals come to life, tailored specifically for toddlers and preschoolers.
signals.note: dropped: venue cap (2/venue); Confirmed on pptheatre.com and entase.com.

signals.title: 'Tesserae: Layers of Time' Family Heritage Festival
signals.location: Episcopal Basilica of Philippopolis and Small Basilica, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Interactive weekend event featuring children's craft workshops, mosaic-making games, and theatrical animations staged inside the ancient Roman basilicas.

signals.title: Holiday Puppet Show: Super Snezhko and the Christmas Spirit
signals.reason: An energetic, cheerful holiday production following a superhero snowman on a mission to restore holiday cheer through humor and catchy songs.

signals.title: Puppet Play: Pulling the Giant Turnip (Дядо вади ряпа)
signals.location: Konstantin Velichkov Drama and Puppet Theatre, Pazardzhik
signals.reason: A lively physical puppet adaptation of the classic teamwork fairy tale, easily accessible and fun for a 4-year-old.
signals.note: Confirmed on kupibileti.bg; venue is ~35 minutes from Plovdiv.

signals.title: Children's Black & White Christmas Fest
signals.reason: Indoor holiday gathering with interactive children's games, costumed animators, and treats, featuring free admission for children under 7.

signals.title: Regional Natural History Museum Plovdiv
signals.reason: A beloved family staple featuring an expansive aquarium, live butterfly pavilion, terrarium, and life-sized animatronic dinosaurs, ideal for escaping bad weather.

signals.title: Aviation Museum Krumovo
signals.reason: An outdoor airfield packed with dozens of real planes and helicopters that a 4-year-old can walk right up to, offering wide open space to roam (free for under 7).

signals.title: Permanent Closure of Sever Bus Station and Rerouting of 33 Intercity Lines
signals.location: Avtogara Sever, Dimitar Stambolov Blvd, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Direct municipal transport disruption: the private North bus terminal shuts down permanently ahead of demolition, rerouting all 33 regional routes to Rhodopi and Yug stations.
signals.note: Confirmed on marica.bg and bnr.bg (Radio Plovdiv).

signals.title: Street Resurfacing and Sidewalk Paving Completion on Krali Marko and G. M. Dimitrov
signals.location: Ulitsa Krali Marko and Ulitsa G. M. Dimitrov, Tsentralen District, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Central road resurfacing wraps up with final sidewalk repaving and underground waste container installations directly affecting central pedestrian and vehicle access.

signals.title: Municipal Christmas Tree Lighting and Central Ice Rink Opening
signals.location: Stefan Stambolov Square and Central Square, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Official citywide illumination ceremony and opening of the main outdoor ice rink, generating heavy pedestrian traffic and disruption across the central squares.

signals.title: Saké @ International Fair Headlined by Innellea
signals.location: Hall 2, International Fair Plovdiv, bul. Tsar Boris III Obedinitel 37, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Large-scale melodic techno production featuring prominent German electronic artist Innellea; strictly music-driven and non-verbal.

signals.title: Christmas in Plovdiv Holiday Market & Tangra Live Open-Air Concert
signals.location: Central Square (in front of Central Post Office), Plovdiv
signals.reason: European-style open-air market with international street food chalets, festive stalls, and a free Saturday evening live concert by Bulgarian rock outfit Tangra.

signals.title: National Ballet of Georgia Sukhishvili
signals.reason: World-renowned touring dance company delivering a powerful, high-production fusion of traditional choreography and athletic acrobatics; entirely non-verbal.

signals.title: Christmas Concert of the Vienna Schönbrunn Orchestra
signals.reason: Touring symphonic orchestra performing classical Viennese waltzes and seasonal masterworks; purely instrumental with zero language barrier.

signals.title: Bistro Blyan: Seasonal Living-Room Tasting Menu
signals.reason: Distinctive permanent concept focused on seasonal regional produce, house fermentations, and an intimate tasting menu without alcohol centrality.
